title: GlowingDroppedCrops
description: A mod that gives glowing effects to crops.
body:
you can highlight the dropped crops when you use the diamond hoe against a block.

crops that you can highlight
・wheat
・wheat seeds
・beetroot
・beetroot seeds
・carrot
・potato
・melon
・pumpkin
・nether wart
・chorus fruit
・chorus flower
